name: omxterm
description: Open-source personal desktop terminal for ARM64 macOS, Linux, and Windows
author: Luiz Otávio Miranda

scripts.check:portable: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && npm run package-built:mac
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && npm run package-built:linux
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run package-built:win
scripts.package:win:x64: npm run build && npm run package-built:win:x64
scripts.package-built:linux: node scripts/prepare-linux-launcher.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux AppImage --arm64 --publish never && node scripts/package-linux-assets.mjs
scripts.check: npm run check:portable && npm run package-built:mac && npm run package:verify
scripts.check:linux: npm run check:portable && npm run package-built:linux && npm run package:verify
